name: Controls
does: The cog-menu Controls panel every game shares: X, Y and touch look sensitivity, invert Y, a key list, saved per game.

name: Models
does: three.js models apps share (the rocket roadster; shrubs and cacti) and the shapes and GLB writer model scripts build with. Plain TS on three; each app brings its own materials.

name: Native renderer
does: Spike: a Rusty Buns app's page, unchanged, run in Bun on a DOM whose changes go out as ops for a Rust engine to lay out and paint, with input coming back as DOM events. Mirror is the TS twin of that engine.

name: Rigs
does: auto-rig's voxel rigger (skeleton and skin weights from any mesh), its wire codec, the GLB bake that feeds it, and the closed-chain IK that poses the result. auto-rig and Mythic Masters share it; the Rust twin stays in apps/auto-rig/native.

name: Terrain
does: Ground for the 3D example apps: real park heightmaps (the seven zones), noise-and-stamp terrain, and level pads. No dependencies, plain TS.

name: UI kit
does: The soft, bold UI kit: design tokens and small DOM components (button, chip, toggle, slider, tabs, panel, dialog, toast) that a game re-themes with CSS custom properties. No dependencies.
